Name: WORLD_MAP_LEGACY_CONV_PARAM_ST
Description: Connection points between maps for the world map: each row links a source map to a destination map by one matching point, so positions in the source map can be converted to the destination map. Unused in AC6.

Fields.Name: Source Map Area
Fields.Description: Source map ID: area number (AA of mAA_BB_CC_00).

Fields.Name: Source Map Block X
Fields.Description: Source map ID: grid X (BB of mAA_BB_CC_00).

Fields.Name: Source Map Block Z
Fields.Description: Source map ID: grid Z (CC of mAA_BB_CC_00).

Fields.Name: Source Map Coordinate: X
Fields.Description: X of the reference point, in source map coordinates.

Fields.Name: Source Map Coordinate: Y
Fields.Description: Y (height) of the reference point, in source map coordinates.

Fields.Name: Source Map Coordinate: Z
Fields.Description: Z of the reference point, in source map coordinates.

Fields.Name: Destination Map Area
Fields.Description: Destination map ID: area number (AA of mAA_BB_CC_00).

Fields.Name: Destination Map Block X
Fields.Description: Destination map ID: grid X (BB of mAA_BB_CC_00).

Fields.Name: Destination Map Block Z
Fields.Description: Destination map ID: grid Z (CC of mAA_BB_CC_00).

Fields.Name: Destination Map Coordinate: X
Fields.Description: X of the same point, in destination map coordinates.

Fields.Name: Destination Map Coordinate: Y
Fields.Description: Y (height) of the same point, in destination map coordinates.

Fields.Name: Destination Map Coordinate: Z
Fields.Description: Z of the same point, in destination map coordinates.

Fields.Name: Is Base Point
Fields.Description: If ON, this row is the base connection point of its source map. Every source map ID has exactly one base connection point.
